# Nous

Nous sets the vault on a warm parchment canvas with medium-weight serif headlines, LaTeX-style booktabs and display math, and one warm palette shared by light and dark modes. It adds theorem-style callouts and recolors Mermaid diagrams to match. Per-note paper or handwriting modes are switched from frontmatter and bring drop caps, numbered sections or a script body.

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Nous"
    author: "islgl"
    repo:   "islgl/nous-obsidian-theme"
    slug:   "nous"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/nous"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/islgl/nous-obsidian-theme"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/islgl/nous-obsidian-theme/HEAD/"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Style your vault with a warm parchment canvas, medium-weight serif headlines, LaTeX-style booktabs and display math, and a consistent warm palette in both light and dark modes. Add theorem-style callouts, Mermaid diagrams recolored to match, and flip per-note \"paper\" or \"handwriting\" modes via frontmatter for drop caps, numbered sections, or script body."
}
```
